summary: The current organic starter remains one coherent payment EOD restart/control incident. The latest environment changes replace artificial no-op baselines with plausible but incomplete legacy checks: partial integrity, reconciliation and operational controls now appear to do useful work while still missing the documented invariants. The 29 manifestations remain coupled through six root-cause clusters and a shared restart-to-close lifecycle, so local repairs can still produce inconsistent downstream state.

evidence.observation: The solver contract remains one restart incident with durable-state, publication and close outcomes.

Controller now contains plausible partial checks for orphan state and outcome counts rather than synthetic forced failures; those checks still compose the same execution/integrity/reconciliation/publication/close chain.

Legacy reconciliation metrics are non-trivial but intentionally incomplete or wrongly scoped, creating realistic partial-fix traps for cycle scope, invalid effects, mismatches and ledger completeness.
Current private design records 29 manifestations, six causal clusters and 27 causal edges and has been synchronized to the organic starter's partial metrics.
Reference solution filters legacy aggregate patch sections for organically rewritten files, repairs those files directly, adds database guards and executes the real batch.
Complexity gate passes at 3080 substantive LOC / 29 manifestations / six roots / 37 tests; Oracle passes 37/37 and NOP has the exact 30 F2P / 7 P2P split.

do_not_change: Do not reintroduce synthetic no-op controls merely to make defects easier to count.
Do not expose the private 29-defect inventory to the solver.
Do not collapse reconciliation, publication and close into one success condition.
